Name: Amasa, Son of Ithra
Summary: Amasa, son of Ithra and of Abigail, David's sister, commanded Absalom's army in the revolt. David forgave him and made him commander in Joab's place, and Joab murdered him at Gibeon while greeting him as a brother.
KeyStory: Amasa led Absalom's revolt, was forgiven and promoted — then murdered by Joab with a greeting kiss.
RelatedPeople: Ithra; Abigail, Daughter of Nahash; King David; Joab
LifeLesson: Forgiveness from a king is no shield against a rival's dagger.
